title: You Can’t Choose a Worse Hiding Spot Than This
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On October 19, 2022, an Ozaukee County Sheriff’s Deputy attempted to pull over a speeding vehicle in Port Washington, WI. The vehicle refused to pull over and fled at a high rate of speed. A minute later, the suspect vehicle struck a Port Washington Police Officer sitting on the on-ramp shoulder. Two males fled the vehicle on foot, crossing the four-lane interstate. Eventually, the passenger was apprehended in a parking lot and the driver was found in a very poor hiding spot. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
